neighbor: Ruth, on the next ridge over

quests.title: Fill the rain barrel and filter a day's water
quests.reason: Rain and the spring are free, but nobody should drink them raw: the barrel stores water, the filter makes it safe.

reward.line: Ruth drops off two jugs of her well water to tide you over.

quests.title: Gather a week of firewood from the deadfall
quests.reason: The stove and the firepit burn about 90 lbs a week. The deadfall is free, but someone has to walk out and haul it.

reward.line: Ruth pays you for a few armloads of split kindling.

quests.title: Build a raised bed and plant it
quests.reason: A bed needs soil once, then seed and compost each season. Dig clay from the bank or buy a few bags.

reward.line: Ruth splits her seed potatoes with you and shows you where to plant them.

quests.title: Start a compost pile with leaf litter and kitchen scraps
quests.reason: Greens from the meadow, browns from the litter or a bale of straw, and some water: your first closed loop.

reward.line: Ruth trades a sack of her chicken feed for a look at your pile.

quests.title: Set an auto-gather rule so you never run out of water
quests.reason: Keep a week of water on hand without thinking about it. While you're at it, a standing grocery order keeps the pantry from running dry.

reward.line: Ruth brings a box of her canned beans and tomatoes.

quests.title: Add a chicken coop and keep the hens fed
quests.reason: Twelve hens lay about 55 eggs a week. They need feed: find it on the Chicken feed page.

reward.line: Ruth's grandson helps you finish the run and won't take money for it.

quests.title: Get through the first cold snap warm
quests.reason: A tiny stove can't keep a canvas tent warm on a hard night. A mass heater stores the fire's heat; the cheapest heat of all is heat you don't lose.

reward.line: Ruth's family brings a truckload of split oak.

quests.title: Cover 25% of your food from the land for a month
quests.reason: This is what the stockpile was buying time for: food you grew, laid, or foraged, a quarter of what you eat.

reward.line: Ruth throws you a harvest supper and sends the leftovers home.
